title: 區域冷卻管網
summary: 以「冷量傳輸、壓降與低溫差診斷」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow cooling transfer, pressure loss and low-temperature-difference diagnosis through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 冷量與水流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cooling duty and flow: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 冷量與水流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cooling duty and flow and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 冷量由質量流率、比熱與供回水溫差決定；流量不能獨立代表服務量。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling duty is mass flow times heat capacity and temperature difference; flow alone does not measure service.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K；計算 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW。適用限制：水的定比熱近似。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: Qcool=m cp DeltaT;m=20 kg/s;cp=4.18 kJ/kg/K;DeltaT=6K; calculation 20*4.18*6 = 501.6 kW. Applicability: Constant water heat-capacity approximation.
steps.failure: 高流量低溫差可能仍傳送不足冷量。
steps.failureEn: High flow with low temperature difference can still deliver insufficient cooling.
steps.check: 改變溫差並保持流量，觀察冷量。
steps.checkEn: Vary temperature difference at fixed flow and observe duty.

knowledge.title: 冷量與水流
knowledge.text: 冷量由質量流率、比熱與供回水溫差決定；流量不能獨立代表服務量。

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「冷量與水流」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 501.6 kW，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「高流量低溫差可能仍傳送不足冷量。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
knowledge.textEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for cooling duty and flow, first reproduce 501.6 kW, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "High flow with low temperature difference can still deliver insufficient cooling." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「區域冷卻管網」的「冷量與水流：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市環境觀測任務」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Cooling duty and flow: Mechanism and observation” in “District-cooling pipe networks”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban environmental observation mission” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.explanationEn: Cooling duty is mass flow times heat capacity and temperature difference; flow alone does not measure service. Vary temperature difference at fixed flow and observe duty.

steps.title: 管徑與流速：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pipe diameter and velocity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 管徑與流速 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pipe diameter and velocity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 流速影響壓降、噪音和控制；管徑以截面平方影響速度。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity affects pressure drop, noise and control; diameter changes area quadratically.
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: v=4Q/(pi D^2);Q=0.02 m3/s;D=0.15m; calculation 4*0.02/(pi*0.15**2) = 1.13177 m/s. Applicability: Full flow in one circular pipe.
steps.failure: 內徑與公稱管徑混用會偏移壓降估算。
steps.failureEn: Mixing internal and nominal diameters biases pressure loss.
steps.check: 管徑減少10%，比較流速增加幅度。
steps.checkEn: Reduce diameter ten percent and compare velocity increase.

knowledge.textEn: Reduce diameter ten percent and compare velocity increase.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 在「管徑與流速」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.13177 m/s，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「內徑與公稱管徑混用會偏移壓降估算。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
knowledge.textEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for pipe diameter and velocity, first reproduce 1.13177 m/s, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Mixing internal and nominal diameters biases pressure loss." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

quiz.question: 哪一項能用來驗證本步的工程判斷？
quiz.questionEn: Which action can verify this engineering decision?
options: 管徑減少10%，比較流速增加幅度。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
管徑減半只會讓流速加倍。
optionsEn: Reduce diameter ten percent and compare velocity increase.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Halving diameter merely doubles velocity.
quiz.explanation: 管徑減少10%，比較流速增加幅度。 管徑減少10%，比較流速增加幅度。
quiz.explanationEn: Reduce diameter ten percent and compare velocity increase. Reduce diameter ten percent and compare velocity increase.

steps.title: 管徑與流速：異常診斷
steps.titleEn: Pipe diameter and velocity: Fault diagnosis
steps.objective: 區分 管徑與流速 的失效原因，提出能排除替代解釋的檢查。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish failure causes in Pipe diameter and velocity with a check that rules out an alternative explanation.
steps.instruction: 內徑與公稱管徑混用會偏移壓降估算。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing internal and nominal diameters biases pressure loss.
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: v=4Q/(pi D^2);Q=0.02 m3/s;D=0.15m; calculation 4*0.02/(pi*0.15**2) = 1.13177 m/s. Applicability: Full flow in one circular pipe.
steps.failure: 內徑與公稱管徑混用會偏移壓降估算。
steps.failureEn: Mixing internal and nominal diameters biases pressure loss.
steps.check: 管徑減少10%，比較流速增加幅度。
steps.checkEn: Reduce diameter ten percent and compare velocity increase.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
